neet_phy_u10_t04_3.working: ω = 10π, so f = 5 Hz. KE goes as cos^2, so it varies at 2f = 10 Hz.

neet_phy_u10_t04_4.working: KE has period T/2, so A is false. R is true: KE is maximum at the mean position, which is passed twice per cycle.

neet_phy_u10_t04_5.working: E = (1/2)mω^2A^2, so doubling frequency gives 4E; I is true. For II, v^2/ω^2 + x^2 = A^2 is an ellipse that becomes a circle when ω = 1 rad/s, i.e. k = m numerically in SI units. II is likely intended true, though strictly 'speed' (non-negative) gives only half an ellipse.
